title: Chemostat washout in the layered CIPS world, two seeds: with one random body removed every 800-1100 t, the bodies keep dividing by pinching for 18000 t after the box has filled (8-13 births, generation 4-5), but births replace only 40-60% of the removals so the population drifts down
summary: World: research/alife/collective/contrib/20261026T1819-c44-cips-chemostat-sighting/world.py (the layered dividing CIPS world with an imposed washout: from t=12000, every wash_T one randomly chosen body is replaced by bath medium), noise 0.03, 192x192, t=30000. Persistent splits after t=12000 (labkit K=2000, so births after t~28000 are not counted), with body counts at t=12000/21000/30000: wash_T 800 seed 0: 8 births, 15/10/9 bodies, generation 4; wash_T 800 seed 1: 13 births, 16/11/12, generation 5; wash_T 1100 seed 0: 9 births, 15/12/11, generation 4; wash_T 400 seed 0: 2 births, extinct by t=21000. 0 merges in every run. Without washout the same world stops dividing once the box fills (c40 seed 0: no births after t~16600). So removing bodies reopens division: the survivors grow into the freed enzyme and space and pinch (sheets show dumbbells to t=30000), and lineages pass generation 3. Births lag removals (22 removals for 8-13 births at wash_T 800, 16 for 9 at 1100), so this is not yet a steady state.

finding.operator: imposed well-mixed washout (random whole-body removal at a fixed rate) in cooperative CIPS on a consumed, regrowing fuel
finding.control: same world and seeds without washout (c40's packs: no births once the box is full); wash_T 400 as the over-dilution arm
finding.result: births after t=12000: 8 and 13 (wash_T 800, seeds 0 and 1), 9 (wash_T 1100), 2 (wash_T 400, extinct); generation 4-5; populations 9-12 at t=30000 from 15-16

limits: Deaths are imposed by the washout rule (a body-level removal written in step()); only the births are the world's own. One seed per wash_T except 800 (two). The population still declines at 800-1100; a slower washout or a longer run is needed to see whether a steady birth-death balance exists. WORLD_P {"wash_T":800,"wash_t0":12000,"noise":0.03} (seed 0 and 1), {"wash_T":1100,...} and {"wash_T":400,...}. The flow-reactor finding (20261026T1729) attributed its merges to buds re-fusing with the anchored body without checking; treat that clause as unverified.
